beschreibung: Borussia Dortmund receive encouraging news on Giannis Konstantelias’ injury recovery – Giannis Konstantelias is reportedly ahead of schedule in his rehabilitation from an ACL injury, with Borussia Dortmund hopeful that the Greek international could return as early as February or March 2027.

Augsburg identify Jan Reichert as potential successor to Finn Dahmen – With Finn Dahmen's contract set to expire next summer, FC Augsburg are reportedly monitoring 1. FC Nürnberg captain Jan Reichert as a possible replacement should their first-choice goalkeeper depart.

Reports suggest Borussia Dortmund will move to halt Felix Nmecha’s controversial goal celebration – Borussia Dortmund president Hans-Joachim Watzke has reportedly backed calls for Felix Nmecha to abandon his controversial crown celebration. The club is also reviewing its relationship with the evangelical network "Ballers in God" amid mounting criticism from supporters.
